title: Palantir graph connectivity and person inclusion rationale
summary: Machine-readable explanation of why named people appear in the 1789, executive-branch, EO 14243 and Vulcan/OSC graph branches, with explicit evidence limits.

sources.title: Executive Order 14243 — Stopping Waste, Fraud, and Abuse by Eliminating Information Silos
Office of Strategic Capital Agrees to Joint $700M Conditional Loan Commitment
Company Tied to Donald Trump Jr. Got a Deal After White House Intervened

data.question: Why is each named person listed, and which explicit edges connect previously isolated nodes?
data.method: Repository graph audit followed by conversion of metadata-only roles and embedded endpoints into explicit canonical string-ID relation records; source-backed inclusion rationale recorded separately from allegation or inference.
data.graph_failure_mode: Several records encoded people and organizations only inside executive_ids, owner_ids, participant_ids, issuer_id, affected_ids or embedded endpoint objects. The graph renderer could display the documents while failing to draw traversable edges.

person_inclusion_rationale.reason: Co-founder and CIO of 1789 Capital and documented co-founder of Rockbridge Network with JD Vance; he is the structural bridge between those two clusters.
person_inclusion_rationale.evidence_boundary: Organizational roles do not establish control over public decisions or unlawful coordination.

person_inclusion_rationale.reason: Founder and president of 1789 Capital and reported co-founder of the private Executive Branch club; he is included as a principal of the investment and access-venue branch.
person_inclusion_rationale.evidence_boundary: Corporate and club affiliation is not proof of quid pro quo, policy influence or procurement intervention.

person_inclusion_rationale.reason: 1789 Capital partner and reported private-club co-founder; 1789 later disclosed an investment in Vulcan Elements before OSC announced a conditional commitment.
person_inclusion_rationale.evidence_boundary: No reviewed source establishes that Trump Jr. requested, shaped or knew in advance about the Vulcan commitment. He and 1789 denied involvement.

person_inclusion_rationale.reason: Official records document a former Thiel Capital principal role and current direction of White House OSTP, creating a career-path edge from the Thiel investment network to federal technology-policy authority.
person_inclusion_rationale.evidence_boundary: The career sequence does not establish Palantir-specific influence, procurement participation or misconduct.

person_inclusion_rationale.reason: Financial disclosure documents a senior-adviser role to Palantir CEO Alex Karp, and the Senate confirmed Helberg as a State Department under secretary.
person_inclusion_rationale.evidence_boundary: The career sequence does not establish procurement influence, recusal failure or misconduct.

person_inclusion_rationale.reason: White House trade and manufacturing counselor included because ProPublica attributed the request that initiated or accelerated Vulcan's OSC review to him.
person_inclusion_rationale.evidence_boundary: Attributed and contested reporting. It does not establish a request from Trump Jr., preferential treatment, skipped diligence, loan closing or disbursement.

person_inclusion_rationale.reason: Issuer of Executive Order 14243, the policy node directing broad lawful federal data access, sharing and consolidation.
person_inclusion_rationale.evidence_boundary: EO 14243 is vendor-neutral and does not name Palantir.

person_inclusion_rationale.reason: Founder-network endpoint connecting Palantir, Thiel Capital and the existing venture/political-capital branch.
person_inclusion_rationale.evidence_boundary: Founder and investment roles do not establish command over officials, policy or awards.

person_inclusion_rationale.reason: Canonical Palantir CEO endpoint needed to resolve Jacob Helberg's previously embedded adviser relation.
person_inclusion_rationale.evidence_boundary: The adviser relation documents employment or service; it does not establish later government influence.

new_connectivity_paths: Chris Buskirk -> Rockbridge Network and 1789 Capital
Donald Trump Jr. -> 1789 Capital -> Vulcan Elements
Peter Thiel -> Thiel Capital -> Michael Kratsios -> OSTP -> United States executive branch
Jacob Helberg -> Alex Karp and State Department -> United States executive branch
Donald Trump -> EO 14243 -> United States executive branch
1789 Capital -> Vulcan Series A -> Vulcan Elements <- OSC conditional commitment <- Office of Strategic Capital
Peter Navarro -> attributed Vulcan review request -> OSC conditional-commitment event
conclusions: The graph fragmentation was primarily a representation problem, not a lack of underlying facts.
Explicit canonical relation records now connect the visible side branches while preserving distinct evidentiary meanings.
The strongest supported statements are roles, career transitions, policy issuance, disclosed investment and a conditional financing announcement.
The Navarro process edge remains attributed and contested; the Vulcan financing remains conditional unless closing and disbursement records are produced.
unresolved: Vulcan credit review, conditions precedent, closing and disbursement
Kratsios and Helberg ethics agreements, recusals and participation records
Executive Branch club membership, event and official-contact ledger

caveats: This pass repairs graph connectivity; it does not resolve all underlying ethics, access or financing records.
